metadata.description: Bootstrap shim for the event4u agent-config suite. This plugin ships ONLY the dispatcher hooks plus one install-pointer skill — ALL content (skills, rules, commands) is installed via `npx -y @event4u/agent-config init`, which writes the file projection AND registers the same hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. DEPRECATED as a content channel; kept so the marketplace listing stays discoverable and existing installs keep working hooks.

plugins.name: agent-config
plugins.description: Bootstrap shim — hooks + install pointer only. Install the full suite with `npx -y @event4u/agent-config init`; this plugin intentionally contains no content skills.
